Equipment:
 Governor accumulator tank
 GA Module 3700L

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block
Content and function of GA module:
Pressure vessel: to ensure maintenance of the necessary oil pressure oil system.
Pressure relife valve: to protect pressure vessel.
Air refill valve: to control compressed air flow into the tank.

System shut off valve includes control valve: to separate oil system from oil 
supply in case of revision, mtce

Manual shut off, terminal board, level: drain valve, level indicator, 
manual valves: 
switches for control of air refill and oil pumps.
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
